evd_title: o3 achieved best SPOT performance with 6.1% precision 21.1% recall and 37.8% pass@4
finding: o3 achieved best SPOT performance with 6.1% precision 21.1% recall and 37.8% pass@4
P: SPOT benchmark: 83 STEM manuscripts, 91 author-confirmed errors (47 source papers, 10 domains)
I: o3 (2025-04-16) zero-shot, full paper as interleaved text+images, JSON output, temp 0.6, 8 runs; GPT-4.1 judge
C: 9 other multimodal LLMs (GPT-4.1, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude-3.7, Qwen2.5-VL, Llama-4 etc.); author-confirmed errors as truth
O: o3 precision 6.1%, recall 21.1%, pass@1 18.4%, pass@4 37.8%; Gemini-2.5-Pro recall 10.1%, pass@4 25.9%
T: Post-2024 WithdrarXiv/PubPeer papers; models o3 2025-04-16, GPT-4.1 2025-04-14 etc. (paper 2025)
